title: Selected tape under configuration embedding
statement: Let $m,k$ be tape counts, let $\iota$ embed the $m$ tape indices into the $k$ tape indices, and let $c$ be an $m$-tape configuration. For every $i<m$, the content of the $k$-tape configuration obtained by embedding $c$ on tape $\iota(i)$ equals the content of tape $i$ in $c$.
hypotheses_covered: An embedding $\iota$ from the $m$ tape indices into the $k$ tape indices
A capacity index and arbitrary background tape contents, head positions, prefix, and initial output used to form the embedded configuration
